entities.name: Víctor Liz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor Antonio Liz is a Dominican professional basketball for the Piratas de Quebradillas of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). Internationally, Liz represents and plays for the Dominican national team, where he participated at the 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
